Elizabeth resolves to ask Mr. Bennet's consent regarding Darcy
Mr. Darcy whispers to Elizabeth to go to her father in the library
Father gives his consent for Lizzy to marry Mr. Darcy
Lizzy confesses her love for Mr. Darcy despite her father's objections
Elizabeth assures her father of her choice in Mr. Darcy
Elizabeth reveals Mr. Darcy's actions to help Lydia
Her father acknowledges Mr. Darcy's efforts to assist Lydia
Mrs. Bennet learns about Mr. Darcy's intentions towards Elizabeth
Mrs. Bennet expresses joy and excitement for Elizabeth's future with Mr. Darcy
Mrs. Bennet offers attention to Mr. Darcy out of respect
Mr. Bennet takes efforts to get acquainted with Mr. Darcy
Mr. Bennet assures Elizabeth of his rising esteem for Mr. Darcy
Elizabeth playfully questions Mr. Darcy about his feelings for her
Mr. Darcy reflects on his feelings for Elizabeth and her impact on him
Mr. Darcy's affectionate behavior towards Jane during her illness is mentioned
Speaker reveals Lady Catherine's attempts to separate them have clarified their feelings
Speaker promises to confess his feelings to Lady Catherine soon
Elizabeth writes a letter to Mrs. Gardiner to share important news
The speaker expresses gratitude and shares happiness with her aunt
The speaker invites the family to Pemberley at Christmas
Mr. Bennet writes to Mr. Collins about Elizabeth's engagement to Mr. Darcy
Miss Bingley sends insincere congratulations to her brother on his marriage
Miss Darcy expresses her sincere joy and desire for love from her sister
Jane responds kindly to Miss Bingley's insincere congratulations
Charlotte visits Elizabeth to escape Lady Catherine's anger
Elizabeth tries to shield Mr. Darcy from vulgar company
Mr. Darcy listens calmly to Sir William's compliments about Elizabeth
Mrs. Bennet expresses pride after marrying off her two deserving daughters
Mr. Bingley buys an estate to be closer to Jane and her family
Kitty improves significantly while spending time with her elder sisters
Lydia writes a congratulatory letter to Elizabeth on her marriage
Lydia expresses hope for Wickham to secure a position at court
Lydia asks Elizabeth for financial help due to their limited funds
Elizabeth provides financial assistance to her family through her savings
Darcy assists Elizabeth's family member in his profession for Elizabeth's sake
Miss Bingley pretends to drop her resentment towards Elizabeth after Darcy's marriage
Georgiana develops a high opinion of Elizabeth and their sisterly bond
Lady Catherine expresses indignant and abusive language towards Elizabeth
Darcy seeks reconciliation with Lady Catherine after Elizabeth's persuasion
Darcy and Elizabeth maintain intimate relations with the Gardiners
